rejected_rule.statement: A prescribed officer cannot place an intended lessee in possession of State Land pending the signing and execution of the lease.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: No provision in the State Lands Ordinance which authorises a prescribed officer to place an intended lessee in possession of State Land pending the signing and execution of the lease.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2 of the State Lands Ordinance
